data.name: 001 - Investigate Incident

workflows.description:
This playbook will try to extract all available artifacts from the triggering events, they can later be enriched to allow triage and suggest follow-up actions.

Configuration

Please update the following steps and connectors:

Steps
====
Step: "pre-configure":
1) timeZone to match your instance timezone (ex: "Europe/Lisbon" or "US/Eastern" INSIDE the quotes)
2) The variable eventIdList instructions there are two options
2.1) To get the complete list of events triggered in the incident set the variable to
arrayStringConcat(groupArray(inIncidentEventIdList), ',')
2.2) Specify and replace the number of triggering events to be analysed. Default in the playbook is 50 events.
arrayStringConcat(arraySlice(groupArray(inIncidentEventIdList), 1, 50), ',')

Steps: RunAdvQry, Comment Incident- Using the FortiSIEM Connector define the Target "supervisor-agent"

arguments.adv_sql_siem_query: SELECT phRecvTime AS "Event Receive Time", reptDevName AS "Reporting IP", eventType AS "Event Type", srcIpAddrV4 AS "Source IP", srcGeoCountry AS "Source Country", destIpAddrV4 AS "Destination IP", destGeoCountry AS "Destination Country", if(has(metrics_string.name, 'fwAction'), metrics_string.value[indexOf(metrics_string.name, 'fwAction')], NULL) AS "Firewall Action", sentBytes64 AS "Sent Bytes64", recvBytes64 AS "Received Bytes64", if(has(metrics_string.name, 'policyName'), metrics_string.value[indexOf(metrics_string.name, 'policyName')], NULL) AS "Policy Name" FROM fsiem.events WHERE (phCustId = '{{ vars.steps.Configuration.custId }}') AND (dictHas('fsiem.dict_cmdb_group', (phCustId, toString(eventType), 'PH_SYS_EVENT_PermitTraffic')) OR dictHas('fsiem.dict_cmdb_group', (toUInt32(0), toString(eventType), 'PH_SYS_EVENT_PermitTraffic'))) AND srcIpAddrV4 = '{{ vars.steps.Configuration.srcIp }}' AND eventType NOT ILIKE '%PH_RULE%' AND (has(metrics_string.name, 'fwAction') = 0 OR metrics_string.value[indexOf(metrics_string.name, 'fwAction')] NOT IN ('deny', 'dropped', 'block', 'blocked', 'ban-ip', 'Alert_Deny')) AND phRecvTime > (now() - toIntervalDay(1)) LIMIT 20;

SELECT phRecvTime AS "Event Receive Time", reptDevName AS "Reporting IP", eventType AS "Event Type", srcIpAddrV4 AS "Source IP", srcGeoCountry AS "Source Country", destIpAddrV4 AS "Destination IP", destGeoCountry AS "Destination Country", if(has(metrics_string.name, 'fwAction'), metrics_string.value[indexOf(metrics_string.name, 'fwAction')], NULL) AS "Firewall Action", sentBytes64 AS "Sent Bytes64", recvBytes64 AS "Received Bytes64", if(has(metrics_string.name, 'policyName'), metrics_string.value[indexOf(metrics_string.name, 'policyName')], NULL) AS "Policy Name" FROM fsiem.events WHERE (phCustId = '{{ vars.steps.Configuration.custId }}') AND (destIpAddrV4 = '{{ vars.steps.Configuration.destIp }}') AND (eventType NOT ILIKE '%PH_RULE%') AND (phRecvTime > (now() - toIntervalDay(1))) LIMIT 20;

arguments.adv_sql_siem_query: SELECT phRecvTime AS "Event Receive Time", reptDevName AS "Reporting IP", eventType AS "Event Type", srcIpAddrV4 AS "Source IP", metrics_string.value[indexOf(metrics_string.name, 'srcDomain')] AS "Source Domain", destIpAddrV4 AS "Destination IP", metrics_string.value[indexOf(metrics_string.name, 'destDomain')] AS "Destination Domain", if(has(metrics_string.name, 'fwAction'), metrics_string.value[indexOf(metrics_string.name, 'fwAction')], NULL) AS "Firewall Action", if(has(metrics_string.name, 'policyName'), metrics_string.value[indexOf(metrics_string.name, 'policyName')], NULL) AS "Policy Name" FROM fsiem.events WHERE (phCustId = '{{ vars.steps.Configuration.custId }}') AND ((metrics_string.value[indexOf(metrics_string.name, 'srcDomain')]) = '{{ vars.ioc }}') AND (eventType NOT ILIKE '%PH_RULE%') AND (has(metrics_string.name, 'fwAction') = 0 OR metrics_string.value[indexOf(metrics_string.name, 'fwAction')] NOT IN ('deny','dropped','block','blocked','ban-ip','Alert_Deny')) AND (phRecvTime > (now() - toIntervalDay(1))) LIMIT 20;
